name: Atlanta SEO Pro
subject: 🔴 Atlanta SEO Pro — your website scored 46/100 (here's why)
html:
Hi Atlanta SEO Pro,

I ran a free automated audit on https://atlantaseo.pro and wanted to share the results with you.

46/100
Grade: F

Here's what I found:

  • ❌ 🔍 SEO: H1 Tag — No H1 tag
  • ⚠️ 🔍 SEO: Image Alt Text — Only 43% have alt text
  • ❌ 🔒 Security: HSTS — Strict-Transport-Security not set
  • ❌ 🔒 Security: Clickjacking Protection — X-Frame-Options not set
  • ⚠️ 🔒 Security: MIME Type Protection — X-Content-Type-Options present but may be misconfigured
  • ❌ ⚡ Performance: Viewport Meta — No viewport meta tag
  • ⚠️ ⚡ Performance: Resource Hints — No preconnect/preload hints
  • ❌ ♿ Accessibility: H1 Tag — No H1 tag found

Here's what I'd prioritize:

  1. Fix: No H1 tag
  2. Fix: Strict-Transport-Security not set
  3. Fix: X-Frame-Options not set
  4. Fix: No viewport meta tag
  5. Fix: No H1 tag found
